fields.entries[].data.duration: raw: length of the entry's interval in seconds
fields.entries[].data.hrv_quality: raw: quality grade of the HRV window, no catalogue code
fields.entries[].data.modelid: raw: device type derived from the model id; 1051-1060 are phone-app relays
fields.entries[].data.pool_lap: raw: pool laps, no catalogue code
fields.entries[].timestamp: raw: start of the entry (interval start or sample time), the getintradayactivity series key
